categories.main_business_segments: Nexteer Automotive operates primarily in three business segments: Electric Power Steering (EPS) and Steer-by-Wire (SbW) systems, Steering Columns and Intermediate Shafts (CIS), and Driveline Systems (DL), including Hydraulic Power Steering (HPS). These segments provide advanced steering and driveline components and systems to automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops and manufactures advanced steering and driveline systems integrating hardware, software, and electronics. Key technologies include electric power steering with various assist types, steer-by-wire replacing mechanical linkages with electronic controls, driveline halfshafts optimized for EVs and ICE vehicles, and advanced steering software enabling ADAS and autonomous driving features. Manufacturing is global with 26 plants, supported by in-house R&D and software development centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nexteer's primary customers are global automotive OEMs including BMW, Ford, GM, Stellantis, Toyota, Volkswagen, and leading Chinese OEMs such as BYD and Changan. The company serves a broad range of vehicle segments including passenger cars, trucks, SUVs, electric vehicles (EVs), and commercial vehicles, with a strong focus on electrification and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS).
categories.geographic_coverage: Nexteer operates globally with headquarters in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA, and manufacturing and technical centers across North America, Asia Pacific (notably China and India), Europe, Middle East, Africa, and South America. The company has 26 manufacturing plants, 4 technical and software centers, and 13 customer service centers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nexteer operates primarily as a Tier 1 automotive supplier, positioned midstream in the supply chain, providing integrated steering and driveline systems directly to OEMs. It manages product development, manufacturing, and software integration, collaborating closely with OEMs on vehicle integration and advanced technology solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on profitable growth driven by innovation aligned with automotive megatrends such as electrification, software/connectivity, ADAS/automated driving, and shared mobility. R&D priorities include advancing steer-by-wire technology, enhancing electric power steering systems, developing advanced driveline components for EVs, and expanding software capabilities for vehicle safety, cybersecurity, and autonomous functions. Nexteer also pursues acquisitions and alliances and targets growth in China and emerging markets.
categories.revenue_model: Nexteer generates revenue primarily through the sale of production parts including steering and driveline systems to automotive OEMs. Revenue is recognized mostly at the point of shipment, with some tooling and engineering design services recognized over time. The company also earns revenue from tooling sales and engineering design and development/prototype services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nexteer is positioned as a global leader in motion control technology for automotive steering and driveline systems, with a strong market presence in North America, China, and other regions. It competes with other Tier 1 automotive suppliers specializing in steering and driveline components, leveraging its integrated hardware-software solutions and extensive OEM relationships to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Nexteer reported revenues of approximately US$3.84 billion, a 14.3% increase over 2021, outperforming global OEM vehicle production growth. The company achieved US$6.389 billion in customer program bookings, with 73% representing new or conquest business and 83% aligned with EV platforms. Despite inflationary pressures and supply chain challenges impacting profit margins, Nexteer maintains a strong global footprint with over 12,600 employees and continues to invest in R&D and manufacturing capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nexteer differentiates itself through its integrated hardware-software steering and driveline solutions that address key automotive megatrends, including electrification and autonomous driving. Its in-house development and full system integration capabilities provide agility and high-quality, safety-critical products tailored to OEM needs. The company emphasizes innovation, operational excellence, and customer focus to deliver advanced motion control technologies that enhance vehicle safety, performance, and driver experience.
